python3 -c "
import cv2, numpy as np

img20 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0020.png')
# Plant pot in obs20:
pot_mask = (img20[:, :, 2] > 100) & (img20[:, :, 0] < 50) & (img20[:, :, 1] < 80)
r_p, c_p = np.where(pot_mask)
print('Plant pot rows:', r_p.min(), r_p.max())
print('Plant pot cols:', c_p.min(), c_p.max())
print('Plant pot center col:', c_p.mean())

# Bottom row of pot:
v_bot = r_p.max()
u_cen = c_p.mean()
# Pose 20: px = 0.433, py = 2.616, heading = 270 (-x)
Z_c = 256 * 1.55 / (v_bot - 256)
X_c = (u_cen - 256) * 1.55 / (v_bot - 256)
th = np.radians(270)
# Forward is -x: dx = -Z_c
# Right is +y: dy = X_c
x_plant = 0.433 - Z_c
y_plant = 2.616 + X_c
print(f'Plant from obs20: x = {x_plant:.3f}, y = {y_plant:.3f}')
"
